sentences.hanzi: 教师节还有两天就到了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié hái yǒu liǎng tiān jiù dào le.
sentences.english: Teacher's Day was only two days away.

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽是兄妹，他们决定给老师准备一份特别的礼物。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì shì xiōngmèi, tāmen juédìng gěi lǎoshī zhǔnbèi yī fèn tèbié de lǐwù.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili are brother and sister, and they decided to prepare a special gift for their teacher.

sentences.hanzi: 小明对丽丽说：“我们给老师画一幅画，好不好？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng duì Lìlì shuō: "Wǒmen gěi lǎoshī huà yī fú huà, hǎo bù hǎo?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said to Lili, "Let's draw a picture for our teacher, okay?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽高兴地回答：“好主意！我要给老师写一张感谢卡。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì gāoxìng de huídá: "Hǎo zhǔyì! Wǒ yào gěi lǎoshī xiě yī zhāng gǎnxiè kǎ."
sentences.english: Lili happily replied, "Good idea! I'm going to write a thank-you card for our teacher."

sentences.hanzi: 于是，小明认真地画了一幅教室的画。
sentences.pinyin: Yúshì, Xiǎomíng rènzhēn de huàle yī fú jiàoshì de huà.
sentences.english: So Xiaoming carefully drew a picture of the classroom.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽在卡片上写了很多感谢老师的话。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zài kǎpiàn shàng xiěle hěn duō gǎnxiè lǎoshī de huà.
sentences.english: Lili wrote many words of thanks to the teacher on the card.

sentences.hanzi: 教师节那天早上，他们很早就起床了。
sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié nà tiān zǎoshang, tāmen hěn zǎo jiù qǐchuáng le.
sentences.english: On the morning of Teacher's Day, they got up very early.

sentences.hanzi: 他们从花园里摘了一些新鲜的花，带到了学校。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen cóng huāyuán lǐ zhāile yīxiē xīnxiān de huā, dài dàole xuéxiào.
sentences.english: They picked some fresh flowers from the garden and brought them to school.

sentences.hanzi: 上课的时候，他们把花和礼物送给了老师。
sentences.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, tāmen bǎ huā hé lǐwù sòng gěile lǎoshī.
sentences.english: During class, they gave the flowers and gifts to the teacher.

sentences.hanzi: 老师看了画和卡片，非常感动。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kànle huà hé kǎpiàn, fēicháng gǎndòng.
sentences.english: When the teacher looked at the picture and the card, she was deeply touched.

sentences.hanzi: 老师对他们说：“你们的关心就是最好的礼物，谢谢你们！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì tāmen shuō: "Nǐmen de guānxīn jiùshì zuì hǎo de lǐwù, xièxie nǐmen!"
sentences.english: The teacher said to them, "Your thoughtfulness is the best gift. Thank you!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽听了，觉得很骄傲，也很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì tīngle, juéde hěn jiāo'ào, yě hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: Hearing this, Xiaoming and Lili felt very proud and very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 从那天起，他们学习更努力了，因为他们想让老师更高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tāmen xuéxí gèng nǔlì le, yīnwèi tāmen xiǎng ràng lǎoshī gèng gāoxìng.
sentences.english: From that day on, they studied even harder, because they wanted to make their teacher happier.
